description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various research topics in the field of large language models. There are a total of 10 categories shown. Other categories include History (8.2%), Game&Anime (8.2%), Med & Health (6.7%), Science (6.7%), Law (5.1%), Daily Life (7.1%), Pet & Animal (5.5%), Business (5.9%), Geography (2.7%), and Math (1.2%). The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled within the slices. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
